$comment: Expected shape of site-inventory.json inside an export directory accepted by normalize-migration-inventory. Produced today by a human (or an out-of-workbench script) exporting a source site's lists and fields -- this workbench has no live-tenant collector yet (sharepoint-collection, Part A, is design-only). The critical field this schema exists to capture is lookupList on Lookup-type fields, which stage 3a (analyze-migration-dependencies) needs to build dependsOn edges and which existing sharepoint-site-assessment/sharepoint-schema exports do not currently record.
title: SharePoint Site Inventory Export

name.description: The list's title -- becomes the matrix object's name.

lookupList.description: Required when type is 'Lookup': the name of the list this field points at. This is the relationship stage 3a's dependsOn edges are built from.
